review_evidence: Complete unit inventory covers 555 files: 535 language-specific Linglib/Fragments modules and 20 Linglib/Processing modules; every file owns declarations and 329 files contain 1,839 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.

The fragments are typed lexical/grammatical resources across many languages rather than disposable examples; direct inspection of Fragments/English/Pronouns.lean shows feature-rich pronoun entries plus checked classification properties.
The Processing modules formalize parsing, memory, psychophysics, signal detection and related computational/cognitive models, so neither major subtree is build/test scaffolding.
summary: Retain the complete Linglib fragments/processing unit as reusable typed grammar data and checked processing theory.

summary: Surveyed all 499 listed files: 488 under Linglib/Fragments (per-language directories, largest Slavic 43, English 38, Romance 37, German 26, Mayan 25) and 11 under Linglib/Processing (DiscriminativeLexicon 6, Surprisal 4, other 1).
